evals.name: create-atomic-note
evals.prompt: Guarda esto: En React Native, para evitar que el teclado tape los inputs, usas KeyboardAvoidingView. Envolves todo el contenido con <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='padding' style={flex:1}>. En Android funciona con 'height' y en iOS con 'padding'. Necesitas importarlo de react-native.
evals.expected_output: An atomic note in vault/React Native/KeyboardAvoidingView.md with frontmatter, wiki-links to related concepts, real code examples for both platforms, and comparison table for behavior values.

assertions.name: has-frontmatter
assertions.description: Note has frontmatter with tags, fecha, and estado

assertions.name: has-wiki-links
assertions.description: Note contains [[wiki-links]] to related concepts or MOCs

assertions.name: real-code-not-pseudocode
assertions.description: Code example uses real RN syntax, not pseudocode

assertions.name: platform-comparison
assertions.description: Mentions or compares behavior on iOS vs Android

assertions.name: uses-users-voice
assertions.description: Preserves user's casual tone and terminology

assertions.name: updates-moc
assertions.description: Updates or references the React Native MOC/index

evals.name: code-correction
evals.expected_output: A note that corrects var to const/let, adds error handling, shows loading/error patterns, and links to related hooks/fetch patterns.

assertions.name: corrects-var-to-const
assertions.description: Changes var to const or let

assertions.name: adds-error-handling
assertions.description: Adds try/catch or error handling to the fetch call

assertions.name: has-frontmatter
assertions.description: Has frontmatter with tags and estado

assertions.name: preserves-user-intent
assertions.description: Keeps the data-fetching concept the user described

assertions.name: adds-wiki-links
assertions.description: Links to related concepts (hooks, API patterns)

assertions.name: uses-real-code
assertions.description: Output is working code, not pseudocode
